_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. column.com declares a named token layer in its stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): ten colour ramps, a 71-step space scale, text/lh/letter-spacing type scales, font stacks and weights, radii, screens, grid columns and the product shadow — plus a semantic layer (--bg-color-*, --text-color-*, --btn-*, --form-*, --link-*) that .color-palette--primary binds for the light theme and .color-palette-inverted--* rebinds on dark islands. Semantic roles are emitted as declared (with the var() chain in their source) beside the roles measured on the painted chrome in raw/components-computed.json. One theme exists (light); the infrastructure band and footer are dark islands inside it.
